# Palm Beach Code School

> > Palm Beach Code School offers coding bootcamps and technology training programs in web development, digital marketing, and filmmaking with flexible schedules and tuition options.

Palm Beach Code School is a technology education provider specializing in intensive bootcamp-style training. The school focuses on practical skills in web development (including PHP), digital marketing, and creative media production with various class schedules to accommodate different learners.

## Key Topics

- Coding Bootcamp
- Web Development
- PHP Programming
- Digital Marketing
- Filmmaking
- Program Schedule
- Tuition and Pricing
- Class Times
- Course Catalog
- Technology Training
